newsitem.title: USA: Sylvan ends Natl Education pact, gets fee.
newsitem.headline: Sylvan ends Natl Education pact, gets fee.

text.p: Sylvan Learning Systems Inc said Wednesday it had terminated its agreement to acquire National Education Corp and had received a $30 million breakup fee called for in the agreement.

Douglas Becker, Sylvan president and co-chief executive officer, said Harcourt General Inc's competing offer for National Education, and the resulting increase in the purchase price, made Sylvan reconsider its value equation for the acquisition.
Becker said that for this reason, Sylvan declined to increase its bid.
Becker said Sylvan feels there are "other ways to achieve strategic objectives for far less money than would have been required to match Harcourt's offer."
